description: How hot is the Bitcoin market today? Daily 0-100 heat score for the Bitcoin market, aggregated from 8 components (BTC-Cycle, F&G, Altcoin-Season, Bullmarket-Ampel, Funding-Rate, Hash-Ribbons, Mayer-Multiple, MVRV-Z). Returns score, band label, color, 7d/30d delta, verdict, components breakdown, score_percentile, score_semantics and band_driver — each explained by a note in the payload. Pass fields="full" for `drivers[]` (per component: value, weight, contribution, percentile_rank). [Free tier]

fields.description: Omit for the default response. 'full' adds `drivers[]` — each component with value, weight, contribution (the contributions add up to the headline score), percentile_rank against its own stored history (expanding, with basis and n) — plus drivers_note with the exact arithmetic.

name: arena_get_pulse
title: Get Arena Pulse Today
